Bench: Soumen Sen
 13.06.2024
 Sl No.4
 Court No.29
 (gc)
 (Allowed)
 Crm (A) 1648 of 2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under  the Code of Criminal Procedure filed in connection  Police Station Case No.167 of 2023 dated 21.05.202 Sections 419/420/468/471 of the Indian Penal Code.

And  In the matter of : Raghunath Kotal @ Raghuna  
 Mr. Niladri Sekhar Ghosh,
 Ms. Sompurna Chatterjee,
 Mr. Sourov Mondal,
 Ms. Laboni Sikdar  ....For the Petitioner.
 Ms. Anusua Sinha,
 Mr. Santanu Deb Roy  ...

1. 
The dispute arises essentially with regard to the correction of the record of rights.
The learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and he has already given no objection for the correction of the record of rights in favour of the de facto complainant.
2. Having regard to such facts and the order passed earlier, we allow this application for anticipatory bail.

3. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner, namely, Raghunath Kotal @
Raghunat Kotal shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.5,000/-, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973.

It is further directed that the Signed By :
